sloka: तानि सर्वाणि रामाय आनीय हरियूथपाः ।संहृष्टा दर्शयामासुर्गतिं तु न विदुस्तव ।। ५.३५.३८।।।।
transliteration: tāni sarvāṇi rāmāya ānīya hariyūthapāḥ ।saṁhṛṣṭā darśayāmāsurgatiṁ tu na vidustava ।। 5.35.38।।।।

translations.english: The vanara leaders joyfully brought to Rama all the bundles of ornaments that had dropped to the ground from your limbs as the demon bore you away, and showed them, though they did not know your whereabouts.
